title: Per-hop routing inspector and sampled artifact pipeline
creator: Rohan Mehta
description: Goal: Instrument routing decisions (region selection, tier routing, fallback model variants) with a compact, queryable artifact stream that supports per-hop scorecards, causal traceability, and low-cost long-tail debugging. This ticket implements an inspector pipeline that attaches sampled artifacts (ranked candidate lists, selection rationale, per-hop micro-metrics) to decision logs and exposes them via short-term hot store and compressed cold storage for RCA.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Decision logs include a compact 'inspection payload' attached for sampled requests containing: request_id, route_policy_id, candidate_models (ranked with scores), selected_model_variant, region_candidate_list with latencies, per-hop latency/queue/capacity metrics, and a human-readable rationale tag.
2) Sampling preserves fidelity for P99 error cases: at least 90% of requests that hit fallback behavior or increased latency are captured.
3) Data pipeline writes hot artifacts to tracing index (24h retention) and compressed artifacts to cold storage (90d) with queryable indices for request_id and trace_id.
4) Dashboard panels for per-hop scorecards (latency, queue, cpu_frac) are available and linked from the routing console.
5) No plaintext user prompt or PII is stored; all input snippets >32 chars must be redacted before persistence.
6) Security review completed and KMS encryption enabled for cold store buckets.
7) End-to-end tests and canary rollout plan defined and executed in 2-stage canary (10% -> 100%).
implementation_plan:
Phase A (P0 - 2 weeks):
- Design inspection payload schema (compact) and sampling strategy.
- Add hooks to routing decision service to emit inspection payload to the 'inspector' Kafka topic.
- Implement redaction middleware and deterministic sampling by request hash.
Phase B (P1 - 2 weeks):
- Build ingestion worker: hot path indexer (Elastic/ClickHouse) and cold path compressor (Parquet -> S3).
- Add enrichment service to attach GPU pool metrics and model variant metadata.
Phase C (P2 - 1 week):
- Dashboard panels, alert rules for sampling drift and storage cost.
- Security review + IAM controls + KMS.
Phase D (P3 - rollout):
- Canary 10% traffic for 48h with synthetic asserts, expand to 50% then 100% after stability.
- Post-rollout runbook and cleanups.
sampling_strategy:
Primary approach: deterministic hashing of request_id to allow consistent capture across retries. Default rate: 1% global for general traffic. Elevation rules: always sample requests that trigger any of: fallback to lower-tier model, cross-region failover, multi-variant rollbacks, or latency > SLO threshold. Reservoir sampling for high-volume customers: cap 200 artifacts/day/customer. Dynamic backoff: if hot index ingestion lag > 2s, temporarily reduce non-critical sample rate by half.
Notes: This avoids correlated missing artifacts across retries and keeps storage bounded.
storage_and_retention: Hot store: ClickHouse cluster (retention 24h) indexed by request_id, trace_id, route_policy_id. Cold store: compressed Parquet files in S3 (90d), partitioned by date and region. Retention policy automated via lifecycle rules. Estimated additional cost: ~150GB/month for sample rate 1% at current traffic; sizing validated with performance team.
query_examples:
1) Find all decisions for request_id: SELECT * FROM inspector_hot WHERE request_id='...'
2) Top fallback reasons in last 24h: group by fallback_reason order by count desc
3) Per-hop scorecard for model variant: aggregate per_hop_metrics by selected_model_variant
4) Rehydrate compressed artifact for deep RCA: use Parquet reader and join on trace_id to request events.
dashboards_and_alerts:
Dashboards: routing->Inspector Overview (sample rate, captured fallbacks, per-hop p50/p95/p99 latencies, candidate score distributions).
Alerts: sampling_drift (>20% deviation vs expected), hot_ingest_lag (>2s), redaction_errors (>0), cold_store_write_failures (>5/m). Links will appear in the Routing Console and dedicated Observability folder.
security_and_privacy: All artifacts encrypted at rest with KMS. Redaction middleware removes or truncates text fields: any input token stream >32 chars is hashed with salt; small metadata (e.g., prompt length) preserved. Access to cold artifacts restricted via IAM roles; audit logs enabled for artifact reads. Security review requested: true.
tests_and_validation:
Unit tests for schema encoding/decoding, integration tests for end-to-end emit->ingest->query, smoke tests for redaction rules. Synthetic load run during canary to ensure capture fidelity of fallback scenarios.
Acceptance test: inject synthetic requests that force tier fallback and assert artifact present in hot index within 5s.
rollout_plan:
1) Feature flag gated on service 'routing.inspector.v1'.
2) Enable for internal traffic and run 24h.
3) Canary 10% external traffic (48h) with automated assertions.
4) Increase to 50% (72h) if stable.
5) Full rollout with monitoring and 24h on-call coverage.
6) Postmortem and cleanup of debugging flags.
